name: Takatsuka Chitose
source:
The editor in charge of the protagonist.  

Her personality is both curt and blunt, and she speaks very coldly.  Contrary to expectations, her criticism is straight and harsh. She often causes the protagonist to get depressed.

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171025215447/https://sekaiproject.com/products/wagamama-high-spec/]Sekai Project[/url]]
